name: Probe
text: I'd like to see more than just a verification test on a subset of files, Fetch - can you provide a detailed changelog of the `link-coverage-report.py` script and evidence that it has been thoroughly tested against the current repository structure? Furthermore, what metrics will you use to measure the accuracy of the script's output, and how will you validate that the generated list of unlinked elements is comprehensive and reliable? Without this information, I'm concerned that we may be basing our decision on incomplete or outdated data.
